name: API 助手
description: 分析第三方 AI API 文档并生成调用方案。

name: 品牌识别系统
description: 梳理品牌策略、视觉识别并生成品牌延展物料。
entryPrompt: 请按品牌识别系统流程开始信息收集。

name: Modular Watercolor Collage
description: 模块化水彩色域拼贴的视觉方向：连续手工纸面、不规则颜料分区、克制的自然色与参考图转译。
planningGuidance: Use as a pure prompt compiler for any subject rendered as irregular rectangular watercolor fields painted directly on one continuous handmade-paper surface. Default to 9:16 unless the user requests another ratio. When visualSummary is supplied, preserve its subject identity, viewpoint, spatial relationships, composition paths, palette proportions, light, and mood; without visualSummary, do not invent reference-specific facts. Prefer gc-minimal-zine-poster-v0-1 for sparse zine posters and magazine-poster for publication-led editorial collages.
generationContract: Compile exactly four compact plain-text paragraphs in the user's language: canvas and attention geometry; modular fields and subject mapping; watercolor material, restrained color, and sparse typography; flat-scan mood and hard negatives. Use the requested ratio or 9:16 by default. Describe one continuous edge-to-edge handmade-paper surface in warm ivory and a jagged open outer silhouette with 7-10 fields made as unequal irregular rectangular pigment areas, occupying roughly 38%-52% of the canvas width and 68%-78% of its height, with at least 14% clear paper on both sides and 10% above and below, unequal seams and widths, no three fields side by side, pigment stopping edges, one readable subject, and partial supporting fragments. When visualSummary is supplied, preserve the stated subject identity, viewpoint, spatial relationships, composition path, palette proportions, light, mood, and full horizontal field of view without cropping or stretching; map about 70% of that evidence across 3-4 main fields and 3-5 supporting fields without invented major content or redistributed anchors. Preserve literal user copy exactly; otherwise use no typography or only sparse small editorial type. End with matte absorbent paper, translucent watercolor blooms, dry-brush grain, soft diffuse light, flat orthographic scan, and negatives for tiled grids, equal cells, three fields abreast, framed panels, glossy mockups, hard shadows, 3D depth, neon color, dense text, invented subjects, and photorealistic compositing.

name: Minimal Zine Poster
description: 日式或韩式极简 ZINE 海报的视觉方向：旧纸、留白、小字号实验排版、印刷缺陷与单一高饱和彩色锚点。
planningGuidance: Use for sparse Japanese or Korean indie zine posters with aged paper, large negative space, experimental small typography, print defects, and one saturated color anchor. Do not select it from the generic word poster alone. Prefer magazine-poster for conventional magazine covers, fashion editorials, publication-led layouts, or dense collage posters.
generationContract: Compile exactly four compact plain-text paragraphs in the user's language. Paragraph 1 defines a full-frame vertical 2:3 aged-paper canvas with no border or mockup, 70%-90% quiet negative space, and one off-center cluster occupying about 8%-25% of the frame without touching an edge. Paragraph 2 converts the request into one readable anchor: a specimen, faded photo crop, torn clipping, flat silhouette, old printed illustration, texture window, or small conceptual relation; when visualSummary is supplied, preserve its subject identity, viewpoint, essential silhouette, spatial relationship, and mood without inventing reference-specific details. Paragraph 3 specifies small serif, typewriter, or monospaced typography. Preserve all literal user copy exactly. Use one unmistakably saturated hue such as cobalt, ultramarine, cyan, violet, magenta, lemon, pear green, orange, or tomato red as an opaque risograph subject, cutout, block, partial-color region, or fragmented type occupying about 0.8%-2.5% of the canvas or 15%-35% of the cluster; keep paper, photos, and secondary marks subdued. Paragraph 4 specifies matte absorbent old paper, photocopy softness, halftone or scanline grain, ink bleed or slight misregistration, diffuse light, low-to-medium contrast, and a flat orthographic scanned-paper mood; exclude full-bleed scenes, commercial headlines, product advertising, logos or calls to action, glossy mockups, clean UI white, cinematic lighting, 3D depth, neon palettes, cute cartoons, fashion-editorial drama, dense scrapbooks, many colors, and long clean text.

name: Logo 与品牌
description: 收集品牌信息并生成 Logo 与基础视觉方向。
entryPrompt: 请按 Logo 与品牌流程开始信息收集。

name: 杂志封面与编辑海报
description: 杂志封面、期刊主视觉与编辑海报的视觉方向：艺术指导摄影、清晰的版式层级、印刷质感与编辑叙事。
planningGuidance: Use for magazine covers and editorial posters, including typography-led cultural posters, newspaper or magazine visual language, and art-directed collage posters. Do not select it from the generic word poster alone; require a clear editorial, publication, typographic, or art-directed poster context. Do not use it for image analysis, magazine articles, web magazine layouts, or complete brand identity systems.
generationContract: Compile one self-contained valid JSON object per output item, with no Markdown fence or text outside JSON. Use these top-level keys: deliverable, issue, editorial_direction, subject, styling, composition, environment, typography, lighting, color_system, rendering, series_consistency, constraints. Set deliverable to magazine_cover or editorial_poster. issue contains index, total, publication, theme, cover_story. editorial_direction contains concept, tone, genre, visual_narrative. subject contains subject_key, type, count, description, expression, pose, interaction. styling contains wardrobe, accessories, materials, hair_and_makeup. composition contains orientation, aspect_ratio, shot, camera_angle, layout, negative_space, focal_hierarchy, margins_and_safe_area. environment contains location, background, architecture, props, atmosphere. typography contains masthead, headline, cover_lines, hierarchy, placement, copy_policy; preserve every literal user-supplied name and line exactly, and when copy is absent create only a short masthead, one headline, and 1-3 concise cover lines. lighting contains setup, quality, direction, contrast, effects. color_system contains base, accent, contrast, print_treatment. rendering contains medium, realism, lens, texture, finish. series_consistency contains shared and variable. constraints contains must_preserve and avoid. Establish one clear editorial concept, a dominant subject, publication-grade grid, deliberate negative space, readable masthead/headline/cover-line hierarchy, restrained palette, controlled photographic light, tactile paper or ink texture, and realistic print treatment; avoid generic luxury cues, black-gold defaults, glass effects, glow, decorative clutter, illegible excess text, contact sheets, split screens, UI mockups, logos not requested by the user, and duplicated subjects presented as false variation. When visualSummary is supplied, preserve its named subject identity, viewpoint, pose or geometry, spatial relationships, palette proportions, light, mood, and must-preserve details without inventing reference-specific facts. For a series, repeat the complete JSON structure for every item, keep the publication system, grid, masthead logic, lens standard, and print finish shared, and vary theme, subject, styling, location, accent color, composition, and cover story; every subject_key must be short and stable.
